name: SerpApi
summary: Structured search results from Google, Google News, Maps, Play and YouTube, with an archive of past searches.

api_key.description: a SerpApi private API key (Your Account page at serpapi.com)

notes: Every engine is the same GET /search with a different engine value; the engine's own parameters follow.
Billing counts each successful uncached search against your monthly quota; cached results (identical search within 1 hour) and the Account and Locations APIs are free.
Results come as JSON; search_metadata.status goes Processing then Success or Error, and search_metadata.id is the archive id.

endpoints.name: Google search
endpoints.summary: Structured Google results (organic, ads, answer boxes, related questions and more) for a query.

engine.description: The engine. google is the default.

q.description: The search query; operators such as site: and intitle: work.

location.description: Origin of the search; city level works best. Look names up with serpapi.locations.search. Cannot be combined with uule, lat or lon.

google_domain.description: Google domain to use; defaults to google.com.

gl.description: Two-letter country code, such as us. Pair it with location.

hl.description: Interface language code, such as en or es-419.

cr.description: Limit to pages from countries, as countryFR|countryDE.

tbs.description: Advanced search filter string, for date ranges and other filters Google exposes in its URL.

nfpr.description: 1 excludes results from an auto-corrected query; 0 (default) includes them.

filter.description: 1 (default) enables the Similar Results and Omitted Results filters; 0 disables them.

tbm.description: Search type selector (images, news, videos, shopping and so on); leave unset for regular web search.

udm.description: Display mode selector; leave unset for regular Google Search.

start.description: Result offset for pagination: 0 is page 1, 10 is page 2, 20 is page 3.

no_cache.description: true forces a fresh fetch; false (default) may serve a cached result under 1 hour old, which does not count toward your monthly searches. Do not combine with async.

async.description: true submits the search and returns at once; fetch the result later with serpapi.archive.get using search_metadata.id. false (default) waits for the result. Do not combine with no_cache.

output.description: json (default) for structured results, html for the raw page, md for an LLM-friendly Markdown view.

notes: Each successful uncached search counts as one search against your monthly quota; repeated identical searches within an hour are served from cache and are free.
Paging is by start offset, not page number. num is not documented on this page, so it is left out.
With async=true the call returns search_metadata.id; poll serpapi.archive.get until its status is Success.

endpoints.name: Google News search
endpoints.summary: Structured Google News results for a query, topic, publication or story.

q.description: The news query; supports site: and when:. Cannot be combined with the token parameters below.

gl.description: Two-letter country code; defaults to us.

topic_token.description: Token for a news topic such as World or Business; found in earlier JSON results or a Google News URL.

publication_token.description: Token for one publisher; found in earlier JSON results or a Google News URL.

section_token.description: Token for a sub-section of a topic or publication.

story_token.description: Token for the full coverage of one story.

kgmid.description: Knowledge Graph ID (starts with /m/ or /g/); can only be used alone.

so.description: Sort order for story and section results: 0 relevance, 1 date.

no_cache.description: true forces a fresh fetch; false (default) may serve a cached result under 1 hour old, which does not count toward your monthly searches. Do not combine with async.

async.description: true submits the search and returns at once; fetch the result later with serpapi.archive.get using search_metadata.id. false (default) waits for the result. Do not combine with no_cache.

output.description: json (default) for structured results, html for the raw page, md for an LLM-friendly Markdown view.

notes: Each successful uncached search counts as one search against your monthly quota.
q cannot be combined with topic_token, publication_token, section_token, story_token or kgmid.

endpoints.name: Google Maps search
endpoints.summary: Local places from Google Maps for a query, or the details of one place.

type.description: search lists places for q; place returns one place (needed with data, optional with place_id or data_cid).

q.description: The Maps query. Only needed when type is search.

ll.description: Search origin as @latitude,longitude,zoom (for example @40.7455096,-74.0083012,14z) or with a map height in meters.

place_id.description: Google Place ID of one place; cannot be used with data_cid.

data_cid.description: Google CID of one place; cannot be used with place_id.

google_domain.description: Google domain to use; defaults to google.com.

gl.description: Two-letter country code; only affects place results.

no_cache.description: true forces a fresh fetch; false (default) may serve a cached result under 1 hour old, which does not count toward your monthly searches. Do not combine with async.

async.description: true submits the search and returns at once; fetch the result later with serpapi.archive.get using search_metadata.id. false (default) waits for the result. Do not combine with no_cache.

output.description: json (default) for structured results, html for the raw page, md for an LLM-friendly Markdown view.

notes: Each successful uncached search counts as one search against your monthly quota.
ll, location, lat/lon with z or m, and nearby give other ways to set the origin; see the docs page for their combination rules.

endpoints.name: Google Play search
endpoints.summary: Apps from the Google Play store by query, category, chart or device.

gl.description: Two-letter country code; defaults to us.

store_device.description: Device to sort for; cannot be used with apps_category or q.

chart.description: Top chart to show, up to 50 results; the valid values depend on the store.

next_page_token.description: Token for the next page of results.

no_cache.description: true forces a fresh fetch; false (default) may serve a cached result under 1 hour old, which does not count toward your monthly searches. Do not combine with async.

async.description: true submits the search and returns at once; fetch the result later with serpapi.archive.get using search_metadata.id. false (default) waits for the result. Do not combine with no_cache.

output.description: json (default) for structured results, html for the raw page, md for an LLM-friendly Markdown view.

notes: Each successful uncached search counts as one search against your monthly quota.

endpoints.name: YouTube search
endpoints.summary: Structured YouTube video, channel and playlist results for a query.

search_query.description: The search query; this engine takes search_query, not q.

sp.description: Pagination token (from serpapi_pagination.next_page_token) or a filter value copied from a YouTube URL.

no_cache.description: true forces a fresh fetch; false (default) may serve a cached result under 1 hour old, which does not count toward your monthly searches. Do not combine with async.

async.description: true submits the search and returns at once; fetch the result later with serpapi.archive.get using search_metadata.id. false (default) waits for the result. Do not combine with no_cache.

output.description: json (default) for structured results, html for the raw page, md for an LLM-friendly Markdown view.

notes: Each successful uncached search counts as one search against your monthly quota.
Pages continue by sp token rather than page number.

endpoints.name: Get a search from the archive
endpoints.summary: Fetch a past or asynchronous search by its id, as JSON or raw HTML.

search_id.description: The id from a search's search_metadata.id.

output.description: json (default) or html for the raw page.

notes: Status is Queued, Processing, Success or an error. Searches stay retrievable for 31 days after completion.
Poll this after a search made with async=true.

endpoints.name: Get account usage
endpoints.summary: Plan, searches used this month, searches left and hourly rate limit for the API key.
notes: Free and not counted toward your monthly quota.

endpoints.name: Search supported locations
endpoints.summary: SerpApi's supported location names and ids, ranked by reach.

q.description: Restrict to locations containing this text.

notes: Free. Use a result's canonical_name as location in a search.
